Class DatabaseConfig

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.network.server.persistence.DatabaseConfig
public final class DatabaseConfig extends Object
Loads and exposes the MySQL configuration for the Mesos leaderboard.

The lookup order is:

  1. JVM system properties (-Ddb.url=..., -Ddb.user=..., -Ddb.password=..., -Ddb.name=...) — highest priority, useful for tests and CI;
  2. The file referenced by DEFAULT_EXTERNAL_PATH on the filesystem, if present (typical deployment layout: a sibling db.properties next to the server jar);
  3. The /db.properties resource on the classpath, shipped with the application;
  4. Hard-coded fallbacks (root/root on jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/, database "GC45_Mesos_DB").

The database name embeds the group identifier (GC45) to avoid collisions with other projects sharing the same DBMS, as required by the additional specification of the assignment.
